verdict.rationale: Relay documents an all-in-one platform combining multiple checking/savings accounts, cards with spend controls, bill pay with approvals, invoicing/receivables, receipt capture, and accounting sync (QuickBooks/Xero), directly replacing separate spend management, bill pay, and banking tools, and community reviews corroborate the multi-account and interest features in real use. missing for 10: independent case studies explicitly confirming founders consolidated away from other named point solutions, and more hands-on verification of bill pay/invoicing depth beyond docs and one HN mention.
